recommendation.recommendation: Implement immediate supplemental flood irrigation combined with moisture‑conserving mulching and rapid disease/nutrient scouting.
recommendation.justification: The rice crop in Coimbatore is experiencing acute water stress (rainfall 0.1 mm, humidity 57 %) and severe vegetation degradation (NDVI 0.154, SAVI 0.105). Soil health is high (pH 6.21, nitrogen rich) and market prices are rising (up to 2470 INR/quintal). Immediate irrigation is essential to prevent yield loss, reduce disease susceptibility, and allow the farmer to capture the favorable market opportunity.
actions: Activate flood irrigation across the entire field today to raise soil water to 5‑10 cm depth; record volume applied.
After irrigation, spread a 5‑10 cm layer of straw or biodegradable mulch to reduce evaporation and retain moisture.
Conduct a rapid field inspection (within 24 h) for symptoms of blast, sheath blight, or leaf‑spot; if disease is observed, apply a recommended fungicide according to label rates.
Perform a foliar nutrient deficiency check; if deficiencies are noted, apply a balanced NPK foliar spray (e.g., 20‑20‑20) at recommended dosage.
Apply 5‑10 t ha⁻¹ of well‑composted organic manure within the next 7 days to raise soil organic carbon and improve water‑holding capacity.
Monitor soil moisture twice daily (morning & evening) using a portable tensiometer or gravimetric check; adjust irrigation schedule accordingly.
Record canopy visual rating (green‑cover %), plant height, and any disease incidence weekly for the next 4 weeks.
Confirm market logistics: lock in sale contracts with Thoothukudi Market at the current price to secure profitability.
recommendation.expected_outcome: Alleviation of water stress will restore canopy vigor, lower disease risk, and preserve yield potential, enabling the farmer to harvest a market‑grade crop and capture the current high grain prices.
monitoring_plan: Soil moisture readings (tensiometer) – twice daily for 7 days, then daily until stable.
Visual canopy health score (NDVI proxy) – weekly field walk.
Disease scouting report – every 3 days during the first two weeks after irrigation.
Irrigation volume log – record each irrigation event.
Mulch integrity check – ensure coverage remains intact after rain or wind.
Market price verification – weekly until harvest.
